title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & parallelism
author: Ethan Monroe
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflows (lint/test/release in a single file) have grown slow and brittle as we added more jobs and language matrices. This PR splits the workflows into focused lint, test, and release pipelines, consolidates shared actions into a common reusable workflow, fixes cache key instability, and optimizes job parallelism/cache settings to reduce overall wall time and improve cache hit rates.

Summary of changes: - Introduce .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml and a shared .github/workflows/shared-actions.yml for common steps. - Move language/matrix config to per-workflow files to shrink job matrices. - Implement deterministic cache keys for node and python layers and add a cache warming step for the most common job paths. - Add a small python-based parallel-runner utility to coordinate test shards and reduce peak runner count. - Upgrade GH Actions runner Node version settings to node20 across workflows. - Improve release workflow hygiene: dry-run mode, explicit artifact retention, and guard for required tags.

Checklist:
- [x] Split workflows and validate locally with act (unit smoke).
- [x] Ensure lint job runs for changed packages only.
- [x] Validate caches (warm + hit ratio improved in CI logs).
- [x] Keep release automation backward-compatible (dry-run first).
- [x] Add docs/ci.md describing new flow and troubleshooting tips.

Notes: This is a workflow-only refactor and should not change application behaviour. We saw a 40-60% reduction in average CI wall time in early experiments on the repo subset and a consistent improvement in cache hit rate, especially for the monorepo's JS packages.
commits_summary: 6 commits: initial split of workflows and shared-actions; add deterministic cache key hashing; add cache warmer script; introduce parallel test runner; fix lint detection for monorepo packages; release workflow dry-run and docs update.

review_comments: Asha Patel (reviewer): Great separation. Two asks: (1) can we ensure the cache key is stable across ephemeral lockfile ordering? (2) add a fallback for runners without the new parallel-runner.

Ethan Monroe (author): Addressed both — added deterministic hash (scripts/ci/cache_key.py) and the test workflow detects presence of parallel-runner and falls back to sequential shards when missing. See commit 3/6.
Marta Gonzalez (reviewer): Small nit: release workflow should not auto-run on draft tags. Updated to require 'release/*' pattern and added dry-run. Approved after update.
Liam Chen (approver): Verified cache hit improvements on CI logs; approving for merge. Left minor comment about docs clarifying cache warming scope.
Ethan Monroe (author): Updated docs/ci.md to explain cache warmer and typical troubleshooting steps per Liam's comment. Merging once green.
ci_checks: integration tests: pass (one flaky, rerun fixed)
release_notes: CI: Split monolithic workflows into lint/test/release; consolidated shared actions; deterministic cache keys and cache warmer added; parallel test runner introduced to reduce runner contention and wall time. No product changes.
